_comment: A bundle is either a rule (membership computed from derived attributes, so new policies join automatically) or curated (an explicit list, for opinionated sets like Autopilot MVP). A bundle can be both: rule matches are unioned with 'include', then 'exclude' is subtracted. Rule semantics are AND across keys, OR within a key; list-valued attributes such as 'frameworks' and 'tags' match on intersection. Use 'frameworks' for positive framework membership and the scalar 'framework': null to mean no framework at all. 'path' drives the Building Blocks wizard drill-down. Optional per-bundle fields shown in the wizard before deployment: 'prerequisites' and 'licensing' (lists), 'notes' (text). 'allowConflicts': true marks a bundle whose members are alternatives assigned to different groups (update rings); 'knownConflicts' lists setting ids reviewed and accepted. bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 1
bundles.description: Every Windows policy aligned to CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark Level 1 (plus the CIS Edge, Defender Antivirus and Microsoft 365 Apps benchmarks). New CIS L1 policies join automatically on commit.
bundles.notes: Items marked (BL) are the CIS BitLocker profile, which CIS treats as optional. Expect some user impact; deploy to a pilot group first.

bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 2
bundles.description: Windows policies aligned to CIS Level 2. Layer on top of Level 1 for high-security environments; expect higher user impact.

bundles.name: Windows - CDW Standard Baseline
bundles.description: The CDW-authored Windows baseline: everything not tagged to an external framework, with ASR rules in audit mode and the production update rings. Pilot and UAT rings are in Update Management; legacy Internet Explorer settings are in their own block.
bundles.notes: Local Security Policies (24H2+) targets Windows 11 24H2 and later.

bundles.name: Windows - CDW Standard Baseline (ASR enforced)
bundles.description: The CDW standard baseline with attack surface reduction rules enforced (block) instead of audit. Use once audit-mode results have been reviewed.
bundles.notes: Review ASR audit events in Defender (Reports > Attack surface reduction rules) before switching from audit.

bundles.name: Windows - Internet Explorer Mode (legacy)
bundles.description: Security settings for Internet Explorer mode in Microsoft Edge, for customers who still run legacy intranet sites.

bundles.name: Windows - Defender for Endpoint
bundles.description: Defender Antivirus, attack surface reduction, and firewall, built on the CIS Defender Antivirus v1.0.0 policies. Curated: one ASR policy and the production update ring only.
prerequisites: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint connector enabled in Intune (Endpoint security > Microsoft Defender for Endpoint)

Create the EDR onboarding policy in Intune (Endpoint security > Endpoint detection and response > Auto from connector). Its onboarding package is tenant-specific, so it can't be deployed from a template
licensing: Defender for Endpoint P1/P2, Defender for Business, or Microsoft 365 E5, or E3 with the matching add-on

bundles.name: Windows - Update Management
bundles.description: Windows Update for Business and Defender update rings (pilot, UAT, production) with Delivery Optimisation, update reporting and Microsoft 365 Apps / Edge update channels.
licensing: Windows Enterprise E3 or later for update reports
bundles.notes: The three rings are alternatives: assign Ring 1 to the pilot group, Ring 2 to UAT and Ring 3 to everyone else. Never assign two rings to the same device.

bundles.name: Windows - Autopilot
bundles.description: Everything a new Windows device needs from Autopilot: deployment profile, enrolment status page, compliance, BitLocker, LAPS, local admin control, passwordless sign-in, antivirus and the production update rings.
prerequisites: Devices registered with Windows Autopilot (hardware hash or OEM)
A device group for the Autopilot profile
Cloud Kerberos Trust needs the AzureADKerberos object in on-premises AD when users reach on-premises resources
bundles.notes: Uses the Entra join, pre-provisioned profile. Add the customer's required apps to the enrolment status page.

bundles.name: Windows - Compliance (CDW)
bundles.description: CDW Windows compliance policies: device health, device security and password. Pair with the Conditional Access 'require managed device' policy.
bundles.notes: Also set 'Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as' to Not compliant in Intune > Device compliance > Compliance settings.

bundles.name: macOS - CDW Standard Baseline
bundles.description: The CDW-authored macOS baseline, including Platform SSO, Defender, FileVault and Microsoft 365 apps.
bundles.notes: Defender and OneDrive both allow Microsoft system extensions in separate profiles; check both are approved on a test Mac after deployment.

bundles.name: macOS - Compliance (CDW)
bundles.description: CDW macOS compliance policies: device health, device security and password.

bundles.name: Mobile - BYOD App Protection
bundles.description: App protection for personal iOS and Android phones without enrolment, at Microsoft's Data Protection Framework Level 2, with personal device enrolment blocked.
licensing: Microsoft Entra ID P1 (for the Conditional Access policy)
bundles.notes: Users need Microsoft Authenticator (iOS) or Company Portal (Android) as the broker app.

bundles.name: Entra - Secure Foundation
bundles.description: Microsoft's Secure foundation Conditional Access set: MFA for all users, MFA for admin roles, block legacy authentication, MFA for Azure management, secure security info registration and block device code flow.
prerequisites: Two break-glass accounts in a group, picked or created at the tenant inputs step and excluded from every policy
Named locations marked as trusted (for security info registration)
Check sign-in logs for device code flow use (Teams Rooms, CLI tools) before enabling CDW015
bundles.notes: Policies deploy disabled. Move each to report-only, review the sign-in logs, then enable.

bundles.name: Entra - Risk-Based Access
bundles.description: Identity Protection policies: MFA for medium and high sign-in risk, and MFA plus password change for high user risk.
prerequisites: Self-service password reset and password writeback (for hybrid users)

bundles.name: Entra - Zero Trust Framework
bundles.description: Microsoft's Zero Trust Conditional Access template set: the Secure foundation plus risk-based access, managed or MFA-verified devices and app protection on mobile.
prerequisites: Two break-glass accounts in a group, picked or created at the tenant inputs step and excluded from every policy
Device compliance policies assigned before CDW016 is enabled
App protection policies assigned before CDW017 is enabled

bundles.name: Entra - Require Managed Devices
bundles.description: Requires a compliant or hybrid-joined device, or MFA, for every sign-in.

bundles.name: Entra - Require App Protection on Mobile
bundles.description: Requires an app protection policy for access from iOS and Android.

bundles.name: Entra - Privileged Access
bundles.description: Admin persona Conditional Access: compliant device plus phishing-resistant MFA, risk-based controls, legacy authentication block, session limits and unknown-platform block.
prerequisites: A CA-Persona-Admins group (assign it to each policy)
Admins registered for a phishing-resistant method: passkey/FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business or certificate

bundles.name: Entra - Persona Framework (all personas)
bundles.description: The full persona-based Conditional Access framework: Global, Admins, Internals, Externals, Developers, Guests, Guest admins, service accounts and workload identities.
prerequisites: One security group per persona, picked or created at the tenant inputs step and assigned to that persona's policies
Break-glass group, excluded from every policy at the tenant inputs step
Named locations for service accounts
Terms of Use objects for CDW401/405/501/505 (the grant is added per tenant)

bundles.name: Entra - Guests and External Collaboration
bundles.description: Guest and guest-admin personas: MFA, Terms of Use, risk, legacy authentication block, app scoping and session limits.
prerequisites: Terms of Use objects for CDW401/405/501/505 (the grant is added per tenant)
Cross-tenant access settings reviewed

bundles.name: Entra - Service Accounts and Workload Identities
bundles.description: Microsoft 365, Azure and on-premises service account personas and workload identity policies: trusted locations only, risk blocks and app scoping.
prerequisites: One group per service account persona, plus the office public IP ranges as a trusted location (both set at the tenant inputs step)
Named locations for each service's source IPs

bundles.name: Entra - Tenant Configuration
bundles.description: Tenant-level Entra objects: authorization policy, device registration, cross-tenant access, admin consent requests and directory settings.

bundles.name: Windows - Endpoint Privilege Management (support approval)
bundles.description: Standard users request elevation from IT for anything not covered by an elevation rule. All elevations are reported.
licensing: Microsoft 365 E5 (includes Endpoint Privilege Management), or the Endpoint Privilege Management add-on with Intune Plan 1
prerequisites: Remove users from the local Administrators group (the CDW standard Local Administrators policy does this)
Elevation rules for the customer's line-of-business apps, written from the elevation report after a few weeks of reporting
bundles.notes: Not validated in the CDW reference tenant: the developer tenant can't hold Endpoint Privilege Management licences. Test with a pilot group first.

bundles.name: Windows - Endpoint Privilege Management (user confirmation)
bundles.description: Standard users elevate after a business justification and Windows authentication. All elevations are reported. A stepping stone while elevation rules are written.
licensing: Microsoft 365 E5 (includes Endpoint Privilege Management), or the Endpoint Privilege Management add-on with Intune Plan 1
prerequisites: Remove users from the local Administrators group (the CDW standard Local Administrators policy does this)
Elevation rules for the customer's line-of-business apps, written from the elevation report after a few weeks of reporting
bundles.notes: Not validated in the CDW reference tenant: the developer tenant can't hold Endpoint Privilege Management licences. Test with a pilot group first.

bundles.name: Windows - Shared and frontline devices
bundles.description: Shared PC mode for hot desks, frontline and shift workers: one Entra user at a time, automatic profile clean-up, OneDrive sync, sign-in on wake, fast first sign-in and web sign-in.
prerequisites: A device group containing only the shared devices: assign this policy to devices, never to users
Devices Entra joined (Autopilot recommended); Shared PC mode applies at the next sign-out
Temporary Access Pass enabled if frontline users sign in with web sign-in
bundles.notes: Shared iPads (Apple Business Manager + automated device enrolment) and Android shared device mode (dedicated device enrolment profile with Entra shared mode) are set up per tenant in Intune and are not in the library.

bundles.name: Windows - Copilot readiness
bundles.description: Windows and Edge settings for Microsoft 365 Copilot: the Copilot key opens the work Copilot app, Copilot Chat is available in Edge with page context for work profiles, agentic browsing stays off and Recall stays off until assessed.
licensing: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is included for Entra ID users; Microsoft 365 Copilot licences for in-app Copilot and work grounding
prerequisites: Microsoft 365 Copilot app deployed (it installs with Microsoft 365 Apps)
Windows 11 24H2 or later for the Copilot key and Recall settings

Before licensing Microsoft 365 Copilot: review SharePoint oversharing (site access reviews, sensitivity labels). Restricted SharePoint Search and Purview DLP for Copilot will follow in the PowerShell-based building blocks
bundles.notes: The CDW standard "Turn off Windows Copilot" user policy only affects the retired Copilot sidebar and doesn't block the Microsoft 365 Copilot app; Microsoft is deprecating it. Remove it from customers adopting Copilot.

bundles.name: macOS - CIS Level 1
bundles.description: CIS Apple macOS 26 Tahoe Intune Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1: FileVault, firewall, restrictions, passcode, software updates, power and login window, Apple Intelligence and Siri. Gatekeeper is a separate block so Level 2 can replace it.
bundles.notes: Not applied (organisation-specific or disruptive): 2.5.1.1 Activation Lock, 2.7.1 profile removal password (absent is compliant), 2.9.1.7 passcode regex, 2.9.1.13 change password at next auth, 2.11.3.1 system extension overrides (default already off), 2.13.1 profile removal (set on the ADE enrolment profile). Blocking iCloud Drive, AirDrop and Handoff changes how users work: brief the customer before deploying. Full mapping: docs/CIS-macOS-26.md.
prerequisites: Macs enrolled through Apple Business Manager automated device enrolment (supervised): most restrictions only apply to supervised Macs
macOS 26 Tahoe (Declarative Device Management passcode, software update and Apple Intelligence settings need macOS 14 or later)
Defender for Endpoint, Platform SSO, OneDrive and Edge come from the CDW standard macOS policies; CIS does not cover them

bundles.name: macOS - CIS Level 1 Gatekeeper
bundles.description: Gatekeeper for App Store and identified developer apps, without user override. Replaced by the Level 2 App Store-only policy.
prerequisites: Macs enrolled through Apple Business Manager automated device enrolment (supervised): most restrictions only apply to supervised Macs
macOS 26 Tahoe (Declarative Device Management passcode, software update and Apple Intelligence settings need macOS 14 or later)
Defender for Endpoint, Platform SSO, OneDrive and Edge come from the CDW standard macOS policies; CIS does not cover them

bundles.name: macOS - CIS Level 2
bundles.description: CIS Apple macOS 26 Tahoe Intune Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 2 additions: App Store-only Gatekeeper and software updates, no content caching, Game Center or password AutoFill, complex passwords. Use with Level 1.
bundles.notes: Not applied: 2.8.29 Touch ID for unlock (set to the customer's policy). App Store-only Gatekeeper means every non-App Store app must be deployed through Intune.
prerequisites: Macs enrolled through Apple Business Manager automated device enrolment (supervised): most restrictions only apply to supervised Macs
macOS 26 Tahoe (Declarative Device Management passcode, software update and Apple Intelligence settings need macOS 14 or later)
Defender for Endpoint, Platform SSO, OneDrive and Edge come from the CDW standard macOS policies; CIS does not cover them

bundles.name: Defender for Office 365 - Standard protection
bundles.description: Microsoft's recommended Standard settings for anti-phishing (with impersonation protection), anti-spam, anti-malware, Safe Attachments and Safe Links, applied to every accepted domain, plus outbound spam limits with external auto-forwarding off and Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or 2 (included in Microsoft 365 E5 and Business Premium)
bundles.notes: Users to protect from impersonation (for example executives) are agreed during design and added after deployment. Choose Standard or Strict, not both.

bundles.name: Defender for Office 365 - Strict protection
bundles.description: Microsoft's recommended Strict settings: more aggressive phishing threshold, and spam, bulk and spoofed mail quarantined rather than delivered to Junk. For organisations or groups at higher risk.
licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or 2 (included in Microsoft 365 E5 and Business Premium)
bundles.notes: More messages are quarantined than with Standard; agree the quarantine release process with the customer. Choose Standard or Strict, not both.

bundles.name: Defender for Office 365 - Files and Teams
bundles.description: Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams with Safe Documents, and Safe Links at time of click in Teams and Office apps without rewriting email links.
licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or 2
bundles.notes: Use instead of the email protection blocks where the customer does not want email links rewritten.

bundles.name: Defender for Cloud Apps - Activity monitoring
bundles.description: Alerts on unusual activity in cloud apps, starting with bulk downloads by a single user.
licensing: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (included in Microsoft 365 E5)
bundles.notes: Template-based policies are created in the Defender portal; the deployment lists them as manual steps.

bundles.name: Exchange Online - CIS Level 1 hardening
bundles.description: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Level 1 settings for Exchange Online: SMTP AUTH off, mailbox auditing and modern authentication on, no automatic forwarding to remote domains, no external calendar sharing, no third-party storage in Outlook on the web, and MailTips.
licensing: Exchange Online (Microsoft 365 E3/E5 or Business Premium)
bundles.notes: Check for devices and applications that still send mail with SMTP AUTH (for example multifunction printers) before applying; enable it on those mailboxes only.

bundles.name: Exchange Online - External sender awareness
bundles.description: External tag on messages from outside the organisation and MailTips warnings when writing to external recipients or large audiences.

goals.title: Harden devices to a security baseline
goals.outcome: Applies the CIS-aligned hardened device configuration: Defender, firewall, encryption, credential protection and attack surface reduction.

goals.title: Apply the full CDW standard baseline
goals.outcome: The complete CDW-authored device baseline: security, user experience, browser, Office and update management.

goals.title: Support legacy sites in IE mode
goals.outcome: Hardened Internet Explorer mode settings for Edge, only where legacy intranet sites still need it.

goals.title: Stand up modern device enrolment
goals.outcome: Everything a new device needs from Windows Autopilot: profile, enrolment status page, compliance, BitLocker, LAPS, local admin control, passwordless sign-in, antivirus and updates.

goals.title: Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
goals.outcome: Applies the CIS antivirus, attack surface reduction and firewall configuration for Defender for Endpoint (EDR onboarding is a one-click policy per tenant).

goals.title: Manage Windows and app updates
goals.outcome: Pilot, UAT and production rings for Windows and Defender updates, with Delivery Optimisation and app update channels.

goals.title: Protect company data on personal devices
goals.outcome: App protection on personal iOS and Android phones without enrolment, required by Conditional Access.

goals.title: Establish the Conditional Access foundation
goals.outcome: Microsoft's Secure foundation: MFA for everyone and for admins, legacy authentication and device code flow blocked, Azure management and security info registration protected.

goals.title: Respond to risky sign-ins and users
goals.outcome: Identity Protection policies that challenge risky sign-ins and force a password change for high-risk users.

goals.title: Protect administrators
goals.outcome: Admin sign-ins need a compliant device and phishing-resistant MFA, with risk, legacy authentication and session controls.

goals.title: Require managed or compliant devices
goals.outcome: Compliance policies for Windows and macOS, and Conditional Access requiring a compliant or hybrid-joined device, or MFA.

goals.title: Apply a Zero Trust identity framework
goals.outcome: Microsoft's Zero Trust Conditional Access templates: the Secure foundation plus risk-based access, managed devices and mobile app protection.

goals.title: Deploy the persona-based CA framework
goals.outcome: The full persona framework for mature tenants: separate policy sets for admins, internal users, externals, developers, guests and service accounts.

goals.title: Secure guest and external access
goals.outcome: MFA, Terms of Use, risk and session controls for guests and guest administrators.

goals.title: Lock down service accounts and workload identities
goals.outcome: Service accounts limited to trusted locations and their own apps, with risk-based blocks.

goals.title: Harden tenant-wide identity settings
goals.outcome: Tenant configuration: authorization policy, device registration, cross-tenant access, admin consent and directory settings.

goals.title: Remove local admin rights
goals.outcome: Users work as standard users and elevate through Endpoint Privilege Management, with every elevation reported.

goals.title: Set up shared and frontline devices
goals.outcome: Shared Windows devices for hot desks and shift workers: one user at a time, profiles cleaned up automatically, quick first sign-in.

goals.title: Prepare devices for Microsoft 365 Copilot
goals.outcome: Users reach work Copilot from the Copilot key and Edge, with agentic features and Recall held back until assessed.

goals.title: Protect email from phishing and malware
goals.outcome: Anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-spam, anti-malware, Safe Attachments and Safe Links for every mailbox, to Microsoft's recommended settings.

goals.title: Protect files and Teams
goals.outcome: Malicious files in SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams are detected and locked, and links in Teams and Office apps are checked when clicked.

goals.title: Monitor cloud app activity
goals.outcome: Alerts on unusual activity in cloud apps, such as a user downloading large amounts of data.

goals.title: Lock down Exchange Online
goals.outcome: Legacy SMTP authentication off, auditing on, no automatic forwarding or external calendar sharing, aligned to the CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations benchmark.

goals.title: Help users spot external mail
goals.outcome: Messages from outside the organisation are tagged External, and users are warned before writing to external recipients or large audiences.

towers.name: Microsoft Entra ID
towers.blurb: Identity, Conditional Access and tenant settings

towers.name: Microsoft Defender
towers.blurb: Email, collaboration and cloud app protection (endpoint protection is in Intune)

towers.name: Exchange Online
towers.blurb: Mail flow, anti-spam and mailbox policy

scenarios.title: New tenant foundation
scenarios.outcome: Day-one setup for a greenfield tenant: the Conditional Access foundation, tenant hardening, managed-device access and Windows Autopilot.

scenarios.title: Secure the Windows estate
scenarios.outcome: CIS Level 1 hardening, Defender for Endpoint onboarding, update rings and managed-device access.

scenarios.title: Enable bring-your-own-device
scenarios.outcome: Personal phones with Level 2 app protection, personal enrolment blocked, and Conditional Access requiring protected apps.

scenarios.title: Protect identities
scenarios.outcome: The Conditional Access foundation, admin protection and risk-based access.

scenarios.title: Secure email
scenarios.outcome: Defender for Office 365 protection at Microsoft's Standard settings, Exchange Online hardened to CIS Level 1, and external sender awareness.
